verdict.rationale: Raygun's external-access-token docs list "Sending dSYMS to Raygun" and "Uploading ProGuard mapping files" as supported services, so dSYM and ProGuard upload are first-party capabilities. The evidence mentions them only as entries in a token-scope list, with no guide to the upload workflow and no description of the symbolicated output. Native (non-Apple) debug symbol upload is not evidenced at all. missing for 10: native debug symbol (e.g. NDK/Breakpad/PDB) upload, documented dSYM/ProGuard upload workflow, evidence that crashes resolve to function names and line numbers, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload dSYM, ProGuard, and native debug symbols so mobile and native crashes symbolicate to real function names and lines

citations.quote: Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files
You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files
